'''VX-19''' was a modified [[LOM-series protocol droid/Legends|LOM-series]] [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] with what appeared to be a standard [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series]] head. VX-19 was left abandoned after a group of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] were slain and was taken in by the [[Ardan resistance]]. When a traitor was revealed in the ranks of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], VX-19 was a possible suspect of treachery.<ref name="OaAI" />
